title_hi: Ye column table mein nahi hai
explain_en: The query names a column that doesn't exist in that table, usually a typo or an old name.
explain_hi: Query mein jo column likha hai wo table mein nahi hai. Aksar spelling galat hoti hai ya naam purana hota hai.

fix.note: Suggest the closest real column name from the schema map, then ask before re-running.

title_hi: Column do tables mein hai, kaunsa chahiye saaf nahi
explain_en: Two joined tables both have a column with this name, so the database doesn't know which one you mean.
explain_hi: Jin tables ko joda hai, dono mein is naam ka column hai. Database ko nahi pata kaunsa lena hai.

fix.note: Prefix the column with its table name (orders.id).

title_hi: Ye table database mein nahi hai
explain_en: The query names a table that isn't in this database.
explain_hi: Query mein jo table likha hai wo is database mein nahi hai.

fix.note: Suggest the closest real table name, then ask before re-running.

title_hi: Ye column table mein nahi hai
explain_en: The query names a column that doesn't exist. In PostgreSQL, names with capital letters must be in double quotes.
explain_hi: Query mein jo column likha hai wo nahi hai. PostgreSQL mein capital letters wale naam double quotes mein likhne padte hain.

fix.note: Suggest the closest real column; if only the case differs, add double quotes.

match: 42803|must appear in the GROUP BY clause
title_hi: GROUP BY mein column missing hai
explain_en: When you group rows, every column you show must either be in GROUP BY or inside a total like COUNT or SUM.
explain_hi: Jab rows ko group karte ho, to jo bhi column dikhana hai wo ya GROUP BY mein ho ya COUNT/SUM jaise total mein.

fix.note: Add the plain columns of the SELECT list to GROUP BY.
